sloka: प्रसादिते च पवने ब्रह्मा तुभ्यम् वरम् ददौ ।अशस्त्र वध्यताम् तात समरे सत्य विक्रम ॥४-६६-२७॥
transliteration: prasādite ca pavane brahmā tubhyam varam dadau ।aśastra vadhyatām tāta samare satya vikrama ॥4-66-27॥

translations.english: 'O dear when the Windgod was pleased, Brahma gave a boon to you, to appease his anger. The boon made you truly valiant so that you cannot be struck by any weapon and killed.
translations.hindi: हे वानरो ! तुस हर्षित हो । में सीता को अवश्य देखूँगा । क्योंकि मेरी बुद्धि और मन को पूर्ण विश्वास है । सेरी चेष्टा मी ऐसी ही होती है
